dialogues.speaker: Ernest
dialogues.text: I'm the cellar manager here. Occasionally I oversee stock transportation.

dialogues.speaker: Ernest
dialogues.text: The role isn't stressful, and the boss is extravagant — he pays me quite well.

dialogues.speaker: Ernest
dialogues.text: Even without all that, just being in the company of this priceless stash is amazing.

dialogues.speaker: Ernest
dialogues.text: Just think of how few people ever get a chance to even see such magnificence, let alone work with it.
